pages.text: A state of energy E is found $(thing)e^(−E/kT)$() times as often as one of zero: the Boltzmann factor. Summed over every state, the factors make the partition function, and everything else - energy, entropy, pressure - is a derivative of it. The Monte Carlo Engine samples one into a $(item)Partition Function Matrix$(); a billion sorted samples make a $(item)Monte Carlo Sample Pack$().
